{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Enacted Health Savings Accounts, which allow individuals to save and pay for their health care tax-free.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Health Savings Accounts, combined with a catastrophic health plan, are an easier and less costly way for small businesses to provide health insurance for their employees.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Enacted common sense liability protections in the Terrorism Risk Insurance and SAFETY Acts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Negotiated agreements to reduce trade barriers and expand access to foreign markets.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Frivolous lawsuits put more money in the pockets of trial lawyers and leave businesses with less money to create jobs.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Frivolous lawsuits raise health care costs on small businesses, often preventing them from offering health insurance to their employees.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support efforts by President Bush, Congressional Republicans, and Republican governors to curb the burden of frivolous lawsuits.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats' nominees, one of whom made his fortune as a trial lawyer, are beholden to the interests of the trial lawyer lobby and offer no hope for reform of the system.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
